items.title: 1 dead, 6 wounded in shooting at California Spirit Halloween store

items.title: Cost-of-living protests spread to Germany on Halloween as France braces for fresh unrest
items.brief: Cost-of-living protests that began in France have spread to Germany where demonstrations that coincide with Halloween are underway on Saturday, with tens of thousands of people expected to turn out across the country.
